stories.short: Acquisition Entrust + JV produits de sécurité
stories.story_fr: Leidos a finalisé l'acquisition d'Entrust et signé une coentreprise sur les produits de sécurité, en exécution de sa stratégie NorthStar 2030.
stories.story_en: Leidos closed the Entrust acquisition and signed its security products joint venture, executing its NorthStar 2030 strategy.
stories.signal: with the quick close of the Entrust acquisition and the signing of our security products joint venture, we're actively executing our NorthStar 2030 strategy

stories.short: Nouvelle structure en 4 segments dès FY2026
stories.story_fr: À partir de l'exercice 2026, Leidos opère en quatre segments reportables : Intelligence Digital, Health, Homeland et Defense.
stories.story_en: Beginning in fiscal 2026, Leidos operates in four reportable segments: Intelligence Digital, Health, Homeland and Defense.
stories.signal: Beginning in fiscal 2026, Leidos will operate in four reportable segments that are focused on specific, defined capability sets delivered to customers

stories.short: Book-to-bill Q4 à 1,3 sur 5,6 Mds$ de commandes
stories.story_fr: Au quatrième trimestre, Leidos a engrangé 5,6 Mds$ de prises de commandes nettes pour un book-to-bill de 1,3, signe d'une demande supérieure à la facturation.
stories.story_en: In Q4, Leidos booked $5.6B of net bookings for a 1.3 book-to-bill, signaling demand outpacing billings.
stories.signal: Net Bookings $5.6 billion for fourth quarter (book-to-bill ratio of 1.3)
